headline: A law that names a Chicago post office building after Officer Joseph P. Cali.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 6300 N. Northwest Highway in Chicago, Illinois, as the "Officer Joseph P. Cali Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming measure. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on December 16, 2016.
